name: Cox Brothers Food Equipment Repair

about:
Cox Brothers Food Equipment Repair operates from Rolla, Missouri, and has served the Mid-Missouri region since 2002. The company was founded by Nick Cox, who remains the owner, and operates under the Cox Brothers name.

The business specializes in repair and maintenance of commercial refrigeration equipment, ice machines, coffee, soda, and beverage systems, as well as gas and electric food equipment, walk-in and reach-in coolers and freezers, and HVAC systems. A team of four service technicians, led by Travis, performs on-site repairs and offers scheduled maintenance plans to keep equipment running reliably.

Primary customers include restaurants, grocery stores, and convenience stores throughout Mid-Missouri. The company focuses on helping these clients decide whether to repair or replace failing equipment.

Cox Brothers emphasizes fast, dependable service and aims to be easy to contact whenever a breakdown occurs. Their approach centers on guiding customers toward the most cost-effective solution, whether that means a repair or a full replacement.
